sections.title: Start from the onboarding list
sections.excerpt: Start from the onboarding list | Click Create Onboarding to open the setup wizard. It walks you through three things in order: naming the draft, choosing where it will be published (pick Web if you're building an ad landing page), and picking a starting theme. After that the draft opens on the canvas ready to edit.

sections.title: Name and organize the draft
sections.excerpt: Name and organize the draft | Give the draft a clear internal name — this is just for you to find it in the list, and visitors never see it. Optionally drop it in a folder to keep a long list tidy. Keep one draft per ad campaign instead of making duplicates, because separate drafts split your analytics and make results harder to read.
